authors: R.H. Boels, T. Huber, G. Yang
title: Four-loop nonplanar cusp anomalous dimension in N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory
journal: Phys. Rev. Lett. 119 (2017) 201601 (from memory; not shown on fetched page)
claim: From the four-loop Sudakov form factor of the stress-tensor multiplet (integrand from colour-kinematics duality, 1211.7028) re-expressed in a uniformly transcendental basis and integrated numerically in DR, the non-planar four-loop cusp coefficient is gamma_cusp,NP^(4) = -3072 (1.56 +- 0.21)/Nc^2, nonzero at 7.4 sigma: quadratic Casimir scaling breaks at four loops.
theory: N=4 SYM, SU(Nc), Sudakov form factor of a protected operator
scheme: DR with D=4-2eps for IR divergences (Sec. II); no FDH/DRED scheme named and no SUSY-scheme statement; the form factor has no UV divergences since the operator is protected; numerical integration (FIESTA sector decomposition, some MB).
symmetry_argument: None stated for the regulator; integrand from colour-kinematics duality (not re-derived here); UT basis supported by residue checks in 4d loop-momentum parametrization (eqs. 9-11).

assumed: D-dimensional validity of the colour-kinematics integrand (no D-dim cut discussion in this paper).
Uniform transcendentality of the basis (strong evidence from about 10^3-10^5 random residue checks, not proof).
checked_partially: Numerical result; precision of 1/eps^2 coefficient limited (Table 1).

evidence: Sec. II, Fig. 1: topologies (21)-(34), (21)-(30) contribute in UT basis.
Eq. (13): numerical non-planar cusp coefficient; eq. (5): planar -1752 z6 - 64 z3^2.
red_flags: IR-pole coefficients extracted from an integrand whose D-dimensional completeness is not discussed in the paper and with no stated SUSY-preserving variant of DR.
